```{r setup, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

# Shared paths + helper functions
source("SRC/Functions_Paths.R")

# Packages specific to meteorological extraction
library(climateR)
library(terra)
library(exactextractr)
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(data.table)
```

```{r}
# read in catchments and basins
catchments <- st_read(catchment_path, quiet = TRUE)

basins <- st_read(basins_path, quiet = TRUE) %>%
  #mutate(comid = as.character(comid)) %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  st_transform(4326)

```

```{r}
# set time window of interest
start_date <- "1984-01-01" #1984-01-01
end_date   <- "2026-04-01"   # adjust as needed

#set parameters to retrieve
vars <- c("pr",      # precipitation
        "tmmx",    # max temp
          "tmmn",    # min temp
          "srad",    # solar radiation
          "vs",      # wind speed
          "vpd",     # vapor pressure deficit
          "sph",       # specific humidity (can be used for RH)
          "rmin",    # min relative humidity (%)
          "rmax")     # max relative humidity (%))

meteo_catch_dir <- file.path(meteo_dir, "catchments")
meteo_basin_dir <- file.path(meteo_dir, "basins")

dir.create(meteo_catch_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(meteo_basin_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

```




```{r extract-catchment-vars}
for (v in vars) {
  
  cat("\nExtracting catchment variable:", v, "\n")
  
  out_file <- file.path(
    meteo_catch_dir,
    paste0(v, "_daily.parquet")
  )
  
  # Restart-safe: skip if already written
  if (file.exists(out_file)) {
    cat("Already exists, skipping:", out_file, "\n")
    next
  }
  
  # Give extract_variable a variable-specific folder too,
  # in case the helper writes intermediate files internally.
  tmp_out_dir <- file.path(meteo_catch_dir, paste0("tmp_", v))
  dir.create(tmp_out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  
  dat <- extract_variable(
    varname    = v,
    polygons   = catchments,
    start_date = start_date,
    end_date   = end_date,
    out_dir    = tmp_out_dir,
    id_col     = "comid"
  )
  
  dat <- dat %>%
    mutate(
      comid = as.character(comid),
      date  = as.Date(date)
    ) %>%
    select(comid, date, all_of(v))
  
  arrow::write_parquet(dat, out_file)
  
  cat("Saved:", out_file, "\n")
  
  rm(dat)
  gc()
}

```

```{r compute-basin-meteo-from-catchment-meteo, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}
# ----------------------------
# Compute basin-scale meteo from catchment-scale meteo
#
# Instead of raster-extracting over 40k overlapping upstream basin polygons,
# this computes each basin-scale driver as the area-weighted mean of the
# upstream catchment-scale drivers.
#
# Mathematical form:
#   bsn_var[target_comid, date] =
#     sum(var[upstream_comid, date] * area_m2[upstream_comid]) /
#     sum(area_m2[upstream_comid])
#
# Inputs:
#   data/nhdplus/flowlines.gpkg
#   data/nhdplus/catchments.gpkg
#   data/meteo/*_daily.parquet
#
# Outputs:
#   data/daily_drivers/basin_members.parquet
#   data/meteo/basins/bsn_*_daily.parquet
# ----------------------------

vars <- c("pr", "srad", "vs", "vpd", "sph", "rmin", "rmax", "tmmx", "tmmn")

basin_members_path <- file.path(daily_drivers_dir, "basin_members.parquet")
meteo_basin_dir <- file.path(meteo_dir, "basins")

dir.create(meteo_basin_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Set TRUE if you want to rebuild the upstream membership table.
# Set FALSE later if basin_members.parquet already exists and you only want to recompute basin meteo.
rebuild_basin_members <- FALSE

# Set TRUE to overwrite existing bsn_* files.
overwrite_basin_meteo <- FALSE

# ----------------------------
# 1) Build upstream membership table
#
# Output structure:
#   target_comid | upstream_comid | area_m2
# ----------------------------

if (rebuild_basin_members || !file.exists(basin_members_path)) {

  cat("\nBuilding upstream membership table...\n")

  flowlines <- st_read(flowlines_path, quiet = TRUE) %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    transmute(
      comid = as.character(comid),
      fromnode = as.character(fromnode),
      tonode = as.character(tonode)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(comid), !is.na(fromnode), !is.na(tonode))

  catchment_area <- st_read(catchment_path, quiet = TRUE) %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    transmute(
      upstream_comid = as.character(comid),
      area_m2 = as.numeric(areasqkm) * 1e6
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(upstream_comid), !is.na(area_m2))

  target_comids <- catchment_area %>%
    transmute(target_comid = upstream_comid) %>%
    distinct()

  cat("Flowline COMIDs:", n_distinct(flowlines$comid), "\n")
  cat("Catchment COMIDs:", n_distinct(catchment_area$upstream_comid), "\n")
  cat("Target COMIDs:", nrow(target_comids), "\n")

  # Routing lookup:
  # upstream reach tonode == downstream reach fromnode
  flow_dt <- as.data.table(flowlines)

  reach_nodes <- flow_dt[, .(comid, fromnode, tonode)]

  upstream_by_node <- split(reach_nodes$comid, reach_nodes$tonode)
  fromnode_by_comid <- setNames(reach_nodes$fromnode, reach_nodes$comid)

  get_upstream_comids <- function(target_comid) {
    target_comid <- as.character(target_comid)

    if (!target_comid %in% names(fromnode_by_comid)) {
      return(character(0))
    }

    visited <- character(0)
    queue <- target_comid

    while (length(queue) > 0) {
      current <- queue[1]
      queue <- queue[-1]

      if (current %in% visited) next

      visited <- c(visited, current)

      current_fromnode <- fromnode_by_comid[[current]]
      ups <- upstream_by_node[[current_fromnode]]

      if (!is.null(ups)) {
        ups <- as.character(ups)
        ups <- setdiff(ups, visited)
        queue <- unique(c(queue, ups))
      }
    }

    visited
  }

  member_list <- vector("list", nrow(target_comids))

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(target_comids))) {
    cid <- target_comids$target_comid[i]

    if (i %% 100 == 0 || i == 1 || i == nrow(target_comids)) {
      message("Building upstream membership ", i, " of ", nrow(target_comids), ": ", cid)
    }

    ups <- get_upstream_comids(cid)

    if (!length(ups)) {
      member_list[[i]] <- NULL
      next
    }

    member_list[[i]] <- data.frame(
      target_comid = cid,
      upstream_comid = ups,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }

  basin_members <- bind_rows(member_list) %>%
    left_join(catchment_area, by = "upstream_comid") %>%
    filter(!is.na(area_m2)) %>%
    mutate(
      target_comid = as.character(target_comid),
      upstream_comid = as.character(upstream_comid),
      area_m2 = as.numeric(area_m2)
    )

  write_parquet(basin_members, basin_members_path)

  cat("\nWrote basin membership table to:", basin_members_path, "\n")
  cat("Rows:", nrow(basin_members), "\n")
  cat("Target COMIDs:", n_distinct(basin_members$target_comid), "\n")
  cat("Upstream COMIDs:", n_distinct(basin_members$upstream_comid), "\n")

  basin_members %>%
    group_by(target_comid) %>%
    summarise(
      n_upstream = n(),
      total_area_m2 = sum(area_m2, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      n_targets = n(),
      min_upstream = min(n_upstream),
      median_upstream = median(n_upstream),
      max_upstream = max(n_upstream),
      min_area_m2 = min(total_area_m2),
      max_area_m2 = max(total_area_m2)
    ) %>%
    print()

  rm(flowlines, catchment_area, target_comids, flow_dt, reach_nodes, member_list, basin_members)
  gc()

} else {
  cat("\nUsing existing basin membership table:", basin_members_path, "\n")
}

# ----------------------------
# 2) Compute basin-scale meteo from catchment-scale meteo
#
# For each variable:
#   read catchment meteo file
#   join to basin_members by upstream_comid
#   area-weight to target_comid/date
#   write bsn_* parquet
# ----------------------------

cat("\nComputing basin-scale meteo from catchment-scale meteo...\n")

con <- dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb(), dbdir = ":memory:")

dbExecute(con, "PRAGMA threads=8")
dbExecute(con, "PRAGMA memory_limit='20GB'")

for (v in vars) {

  cat("\nComputing basin variable:", v, "\n")

  in_file <- file.path(meteo_dir, paste0("/catchments/",v, "_daily.parquet"))
  out_file <- file.path(meteo_basin_dir, paste0("bsn_", v, "_daily.parquet"))

  if (!file.exists(in_file)) {
    stop("Missing catchment meteo file: ", in_file)
  }

  if (file.exists(out_file) && !overwrite_basin_meteo) {
    cat("Already exists, skipping:", out_file, "\n")
    next
  }

  if (file.exists(out_file) && overwrite_basin_meteo) {
    file.remove(out_file)
  }

  sql <- paste0("
    COPY (
      SELECT
        m.target_comid AS comid,
        d.date,
        SUM(d.", v, " * m.area_m2) / SUM(m.area_m2) AS bsn_", v, "
      FROM read_parquet('", basin_members_path, "') m
      INNER JOIN read_parquet('", in_file, "') d
        ON CAST(m.upstream_comid AS VARCHAR) = CAST(d.comid AS VARCHAR)
      WHERE d.", v, " IS NOT NULL
        AND m.area_m2 IS NOT NULL
      GROUP BY
        m.target_comid,
        d.date
    )
    TO '", out_file, "'
    (FORMAT PARQUET, COMPRESSION ZSTD);
  ")

  dbExecute(con, sql)

  check <- dbGetQuery(con, paste0("
    SELECT
      COUNT(*) AS n_rows,
      COUNT(DISTINCT comid) AS n_comids,
      MIN(date) AS min_date,
      MAX(date) AS max_date,
     AVG(CASE WHEN bsn_", v, " IS NOT NULL THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS pct_value
    FROM read_parquet('", out_file, "')
  "))

  print(check)
}

dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)

cat("\nFinished computing basin-scale meteo files.\n")

# ----------------------------
# 3) Final validation
# ----------------------------

cat("\nValidating key basin meteo files...\n")

bsn_pr_path <- file.path(meteo_basin_dir, "bsn_pr_daily.parquet")
bsn_tmmx_path <- file.path(meteo_basin_dir, "bsn_tmmx_daily.parquet")
bsn_tmmn_path <- file.path(meteo_basin_dir, "bsn_tmmn_daily.parquet")

bsn_pr <- read_parquet(bsn_pr_path)
bsn_tmmx <- read_parquet(bsn_tmmx_path)
bsn_tmmn <- read_parquet(bsn_tmmn_path)

bsn_pr %>%
  summarise(
    variable = "bsn_pr",
    n_rows = n(),
    n_comids = n_distinct(comid),
    min_date = min(date),
    max_date = max(date),
    pct_value = mean(!is.na(bsn_pr))
  ) %>%
  print()

bsn_tmmx %>%
  summarise(
    variable = "bsn_tmmx",
    n_rows = n(),
    n_comids = n_distinct(comid),
    min_date = min(date),
    max_date = max(date),
    pct_value = mean(!is.na(bsn_tmmx))
  ) %>%
  print()

bsn_tmmn %>%
  summarise(
    variable = "bsn_tmmn",
    n_rows = n(),
    n_comids = n_distinct(comid),
    min_date = min(date),
    max_date = max(date),
    pct_value = mean(!is.na(bsn_tmmn))
  ) %>%
  print()

cat("\nDone.\n")
```

```{r build-catchment-and-basin-joined-files}
# -------------------------------
# Join catchment variable files
# -------------------------------

catch_files <- file.path(
  meteo_catch_dir,
  paste0(vars, "_daily.parquet")
)

drivers_catchments <- arrow::read_parquet(catch_files[1])

for (f in catch_files[-1]) {
  
  cat("Joining catchment file:", f, "\n")
  
  tmp <- arrow::read_parquet(f)
  
  drivers_catchments <- dplyr::full_join(
    drivers_catchments,
    tmp,
    by = c("comid", "date")
  )
  
  rm(tmp)
  gc()
}

catch_joined_file <- file.path(daily_drivers_dir, "drivers_catchments_joined.parquet")
arrow::write_parquet(drivers_catchments, catch_joined_file)

cat("Saved joined catchment drivers to:", catch_joined_file, "\n")

rm(drivers_catchments)
gc()


# -------------------------------
# Join basin variable files
# -------------------------------

basin_files <- file.path(
  meteo_basin_dir,
  paste0("bsn_", vars, "_daily.parquet")
)

drivers_basins <- arrow::read_parquet(basin_files[1])

for (f in basin_files[-1]) {
  
  cat("Joining basin file:", f, "\n")
  
  tmp <- arrow::read_parquet(f)
  
  drivers_basins <- dplyr::full_join(
    drivers_basins,
    tmp,
    by = c("comid", "date")
  )
  
  rm(tmp)
  gc()
}

basin_joined_file <- file.path(daily_drivers_dir, "drivers_basins_joined.parquet")
arrow::write_parquet(drivers_basins, basin_joined_file)

cat("Saved joined basin drivers to:", basin_joined_file, "\n")

rm(drivers_basins)
gc()
```


```{r final-join-from-disk}
# Final catchment + basin join from disk
con <- dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  dbdir = file.path(daily_drivers_dir, "meteo_join.duckdb")
)

catch_joined_file_sql <- gsub("\\\\", "/", normalizePath(catch_joined_file))
basin_joined_file_sql <- gsub("\\\\", "/", normalizePath(basin_joined_file))

drivers_out_file <- file.path(daily_drivers_dir, "drivers_daily_joined.parquet")
drivers_out_file_sql <- gsub("\\\\", "/", drivers_out_file)

dbExecute(con, paste0("
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE drivers_final AS
SELECT
  COALESCE(c.comid, b.comid) AS comid,
  COALESCE(c.date, b.date) AS date,

  c.pr,
  c.srad,
  c.vs,
  c.vpd,
  c.sph,
  c.rmin,
  c.rmax,

  c.tmmx - 273.15 AS tmax_c,
  c.tmmn - 273.15 AS tmin_c,
  ((c.tmmx - 273.15) + (c.tmmn - 273.15)) / 2 AS tmean_c,

  b.bsn_pr,
  b.bsn_srad,
  b.bsn_vs,
  b.bsn_vpd,
  b.bsn_sph,
  b.bsn_rmin,
  b.bsn_rmax,

  b.bsn_tmmx - 273.15 AS bsn_tmax_c,
  b.bsn_tmmn - 273.15 AS bsn_tmin_c,
  ((b.bsn_tmmx - 273.15) + (b.bsn_tmmn - 273.15)) / 2 AS bsn_tmean_c

FROM read_parquet('", catch_joined_file_sql, "') c
FULL OUTER JOIN read_parquet('", basin_joined_file_sql, "') b
USING (comid, date)
"))

dbExecute(con, paste0("
COPY drivers_final
TO '", drivers_out_file_sql, "'
(FORMAT PARQUET, OVERWRITE_OR_IGNORE TRUE)
"))

dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)

cat("Saved final joined drivers to:", drivers_out_file, "\n")

```

```{r}
drivers_final <- arrow::open_dataset(drivers_out_file)

drivers_final %>%
  head(10) %>%
  collect()
```

```{r}
library(arrow)
library(dplyr)

drivers_joined <- read_parquet(file.path(daily_drivers_dir, "drivers_daily_joined.parquet"))

drivers_joined %>%
  summarise(
    n_rows = n(),
    n_comids = n_distinct(comid),
    min_date = min(date, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_date = max(date, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    pct_tmean_c = mean(!is.na(tmean_c)),
    pct_bsn_tmean_c = mean(!is.na(bsn_tmean_c)),
    pct_both = mean(!is.na(tmean_c) & !is.na(bsn_tmean_c)),
    pct_catchment_only = mean(!is.na(tmean_c) & is.na(bsn_tmean_c)),
    pct_basin_only = mean(is.na(tmean_c) & !is.na(bsn_tmean_c))
  )
  
```
